articles.titre: Ubisoft lay off 166 more staff, this time at their Montreal and Quebec City studios, while mumbling about "current production priorities and business needs"
articles.resume: Ubisoft have laid off 166 developers, with this latest round of cuts at the Assassin's Creed and Far Cry publishers taking place at two of their studios in Eastern Canada. Both studios affected, Ubisoft Montreal and Ubisoft Quebec, had a hand in last year's Assassin's Creed Shadows , with Montreal especially being a major and long-tenured development hub for the company. Read more

titre: Ubisoft : encore 166 licenciements à Montréal et Québec

articles.titre: Ubisoft cuts jobs at major Assassin's Creed and Far Cry studios as its year of layoffs continues
articles.resume: Ubisoft has confirmed more layoffs as part of its previously announced operational "reset", this time affecting 166 employees at its major Montréal and Québec City studios - the teams responsible for game series including Assassin's Creed and Far Cry. It says the cuts are necessary "to ensure our resources are aligned with current production priorities and business needs." Read more
